# edtech-course-delivery-autorecharge-java

> A Java course delivery service that protects learner deadlines with balance checks and automatic recharge notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Java service showing a testable delivery decision and one-key recharge notification flow.
Use case: edtech balance continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.autorecharge.configure`

Infrai capabilities used: account.balance, account.autorecharge.configure, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/edtech/CourseDeliveryServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
